title: Trusted Advisor Check Results and Cost Optimization

controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:trustedadvisor` traffic without `status="warning" OR status="error"`. Confirm UC-4.1.50 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_aws` with the modular input for `aws:trustedadvisor`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.1.78.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Schedule Lambda or script to call Trusted Advisor API (requires Business/Enterprise Support). Export check results to S3 or send to Splunk via HEC. Dashboard by category (cost, performance, security). Alert on new critical security checks failing.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:trustedadvisor" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:trustedadvisor" status="warning" OR status="error"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.50_trusted_advisor_check_re_50"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:trustedadvisor` in `index=aws` to detect trusted advisor check results and cost optimization. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_50_alert` with severity aligned to `low` criticality. Dashboard: Table (check, category, status), Pie chart (ok vs warning vs error), Bar chart by category..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_aws` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of trusted advisor check results and cost optimization so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
